news.paragraph: The iShares Silver Trust (SLV) has seen significant gains over the past year, with recent articles debating its continued value despite some price fluctuations. While one article suggests a competitor ETF, SIVR, may be outperforming, others highlight silver's potential to soar later this year, outperforming gold in 2026. The overall sentiment is cautiously optimistic, with analysts watching the trust's performance in the current environment.
